description: Search by name across organisations (companies, associations, public bodies), communes, elected officials, public officials heading an administration and site topics. Each result has a site path whose last segment is the id for the detail tools (/organisation/<SIREN>, /commune/<INSEE>, /elus/<id>, /administrations/<id>). An acronym may only match subsidiaries or namesakes: then search the legal name (Electricité de France for EDF). Find an administration by its own name with list_administrations.
name: search
title: Search
